COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.942 of 2021
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via video conferencing).
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Advocate, for 
the petitioner. 
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Additional CSC, for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
The Registry has pointed out that the 
writ petition suffers from certain defects. 
However, looking to the nature of the defects,
and the undertaking, which has been given by 
the learned counsel for the petitioner, he 
undertakes that the defects would be removed
by him within a period of one week from today.
The relief sought in the writ petition by 
the petitioner, is as against the decision dated 
22.08.2019, as it had been passed by the 
Committee with regards to the claim of the pay 
scale, which the petitioner intended or claims to 
be entitled to be awarded.
This writ petition could not be decided 
except, without calling the counter affidavit in 
the matter.
In an eventuality and that, subject to the 
condition the petitioner removes the defects as 
pointed by the Registry within a period of one 
week, the respondents may file counter 
affidavit to the writ petition within a period of 
four weeks.
List this writ petition after the receipt of 
the counter affidavit. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 30.07.2021

 Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel appearing for

2. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned S.C. for the State. 
3. Mr. H.M. Bhattia, learned counsel for respondent no.3. 
4. Having heard learned counsel for parties, it transpires 
that the Cabinet decision dated 22.11.2014 was not given 
effect to, rather by a subsequent order dated 07.01.2015, which
is impugned herein, the grade-pay of Rs.4800/- in respect of 
District Adventure Sports Officer and Rs.5400 in respect of 
Chief District Adventure Sports Officer, as approved by 
Cabinet, has not been sanctioned. 
5. Learned Counsel for respondent no.3 seeks three weeks’ 
time to seek instructions specifically with regard to the fact as 
to how and under which circumstances, the decision taken by 
the Cabinet was deviated. 
6. List on 12.06.2024. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Lata Bisht and others …………Petitioners
 Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and others ……….Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, learned Senior Advocate assisted 
by Mr. Tushar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Mr. G.S. Negi, learned Addl. C.S.C. for the State.
3. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel for respondent 
no.3.
4. On perusal of the record, it transpires that after the 
Cabinet took decision on 12.11.2014, the Cabinet again in 
its meeting dated 29.06.2019 constituted a committee and 
recommendation of the said committee was directed to be 
placed before the Cabinet again.
5. A reference to the aforesaid found place in letter dated 
02.07.2019.
6. It has yet not been clear that as to what has been done 
on the recommendation submitted by the Committee 
constituted under the orders of the Cabinet.
7. Learned counsel for the State shall file a 
supplementary affidavit bringing on record the action taken 
by the State Government after the recommendation was 
sent to the Cabinet, if any, within two weeks.
8. List this case on 12.08.2026.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 27.07.2026
